Это значительный шаг на пути к газификации района. В этом году приложим все усилия для включения муниципалитета в программу догазификации.' (Construction of GRS Novorzhev is practically/factually complete in Novorzhevsky District; this year the district will push for inclusion in the follow-on 'dogazifikatsiya' programme.) This is much newer than the row's LastUpdated (2023-07-21) and indicates the ГРС (and, by strong implication, the connecting отвод this row represents, since a ГРС cannot be commissioned without its feeder) has progressed from 'proposed' to at least under-construction/near-complete, i.e. Status should move off 'proposed'. The quote does not explicitly confirm final in-service/gas-flowing commissioning of the 36km отвод itself (only the ГРС), so I am proposing 'construction' rather than jumping straight to 'operating' -- a human should weigh whether 'фактически завершено' (practically/de facto completed) for the ГРС structure is strong enough to call the whole object 'operating' given the уточнение about still needing 'dogazifikatsiya программа' inclusion this year, which suggests downstream household hookups (and possibly final commissioning) are not yet complete.
